name: @n8io/baseline-shared
description: The small helpers the other Baseline Packages share: a timeout race, option checks, keep-alive timeouts and Postgres connection checks. Not meant to be called from a Project.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && pnpm pack --out dist/package.tgz && publint dist/package.tgz --strict && attw dist/package.tgz --profile esm-only
